name: Nawraj Chat Launcher
author: nawrajgupta

sections.description:
Nawraj Chat Launcher is a lightweight and customizable floating chat launcher plugin for WordPress that helps visitors quickly start a conversation through WhatsApp.

The plugin is designed for speed, simplicity, and performance. It uses modern vanilla JavaScript without jQuery and integrates seamlessly with most WordPress themes.

Perfect for:

  • Business Websites
  • Company Websites
  • Landing Pages
  • Freelancers
  • Agencies
  • Portfolio Websites
  • Blogs
  • WooCommerce Stores
  • Local Businesses
  • Service Providers

Features

  • floating chat launcher with WhatsApp support
  • Enable or disable the chat button anytime
  • Custom WhatsApp number
  • Custom pre-filled message
  • Four button positions:
    • Bottom Right
    • Bottom Left
    • Top Right
    • Top Left
  • Device visibility controls:
    • Desktop
    • Laptop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile
  • Button customization:
    • Button Size
    • Border Radius
    • Margins
  • Animation effects:
    • None
    • Pulse
    • Bounce
    • Shake
    • Zoom
    • Floating
    • Rotate
  • Optional notification badge
  • Smart display triggers:
    • Immediate
    • Delay
    • Scroll Percentage
    • Exit Intent
  • Built-in click analytics:
    • Today’s Clicks
    • Weekly Clicks
    • Monthly Clicks
    • Lifetime Clicks
  • Optional WordPress Dashboard Widget
  • Clean and user-friendly admin interface
  • No jQuery required
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • Works with most WordPress themes
  • Translation ready
  • GPL licensed

Privacy

This plugin stores click analytics locally inside your WordPress database.

No personal visitor information is collected.

No external tracking services are used.

The plugin simply opens the official WhatsApp chat URL when visitors click the button.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nawraj-chat-launcher folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Nawraj Chat Launcher.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number.
  5. Customize the button settings.
  6. Save your changes.

The floating chat launcher will automatically appear on your website according to your selected settings.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

Nawraj Chat Launcher adds a lightweight floating chat launcher that allows visitors to quickly start a conversation through WhatsApp.

Where can I configure the plugin?

Go to Settings → Nawraj Chat Launcher in your WordPress dashboard.

Does this plugin require jQuery?

No. The plugin is built using lightweight vanilla JavaScript.

Can I choose where the button appears?

Yes. You can display the button in the bottom right, bottom left, top right, or top left corner.

Can I control which devices display the button?

Yes. You can enable or disable the button for desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I customize the button appearance?

Yes. You can customize the button size, border radius, margins, notification badge, and animation effects.

Does this plugin support smart triggers?

Yes. The plugin supports immediate display, delay, scroll percentage, and exit intent triggers.

Does this plugin track button clicks?

Yes. Built-in analytics display today’s, weekly, monthly, and lifetime click statistics.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes. It works with WooCommerce because it follows standard WordPress development practices.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and loads only the required CSS and JavaScript files.

Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. The plugin does not collect or transmit any personal visitor information. Click analytics are stored locally in your WordPress database.

Does this plugin require a third-party API?

No. The plugin simply opens the official WhatsApp chat URL. No API key or third-party account is required.

Does this plugin include Elementor widgets, multiple agents, popups, import/export, or live preview?

No. Version 1.0 focuses on providing a lightweight, reliable, and performance-friendly floating chat launcher.
